name: Generation composition
responsibility: Starts the private child, opens a Codex connection to each child as it arrives, and builds each generation's object graph over that connection
description: installProductionCodexWorkbench hands the owner lifecycle createCodexProcess, a kernel factory and a generation factory. TASK-653.11: the voice kernel is the Codex connection. The kernel factory opens it with openCodexConnection({ child, recordPrefix }) and registers the dynamic dispatchers only while its transport is open; the generation input carries the connection, and the factories open the session on it with openCodexSession. The factories (generation/factories.ts) build the components in the order they depend on each other, the gateway last. codex-workbench-session-factories.ts builds one tab session's owners when the tab sessions open it. A child's exit drops every tab session, and nothing is resumed.
